- Act by imagining futures before moving: the [Dreamer]{.k} lineage, 2019 onward
- The complement of a policy: it learns [dynamics]{.k}, not behavior


## Three families of world models

| Family | Exemplars | What it gives you |
|:-------|:---------:|:------------------|
| Latent dynamics | Dreamer | imagination for planning and RL |
| Video generation | Genie, Cosmos | promptable, general visual worlds |
| [Neural simulators]{.k} | DreamDojo, GE-Sim | [action-conditioned rollouts]{.k} for robots |

: {tbl-colwidths="[26,26,48]"}

## Two paradigms, one team

|  | DreamZero | DreamDojo |
|:--|:---------:|:---------:|
| Direction | inverse: video to action | forward: action to video |
| The product | a zero-shot policy | a neural simulator |
| Training data | 500 h of robot data | [44,000 h of human video]{.mark} |
| Its job | [acts]{.k} | [imagines]{.k} |

: {tbl-colwidths="[20,40,40]"}

::: {.footnote}
Both NVIDIA, February 2026. The two halves of one loop.
:::

## Where does action supervision come from?

{{< video-card lapa-teaser >}}

- Inverse dynamics models label raw video with [pseudo-actions]{.k}
- LAPA (2024): learn [latent actions]{.k} from human video, no robot labels at all

- Imagination becomes optional at inference: run the [action pathway]{.k} alone


## The architecture consolidated in 2026

| Style | Idea | Exemplar |
|:------|:-----|:--------:|
| Joint denoising | one flow over video and action | [DreamZero]{.k} |
| Interleaved mixture | mixture-of-transformers over frames and actions | [Dyna-2]{.k} |
| Latent world + decoder | imagine in latent space, decode actions | LAPA lineage |

::: {.footnote}
The 2026 tutorial line: imagination is training-time scaffolding; at inference, recent WAMs skip video generation and act at VLA-class latency.
:::

## The race is for hours, not parameters

| Who | Hours | What |
|:----|:-----:|:-----|
| Dyna Robotics | [1,000,000 h]{.mark} | egocentric human video, zero robot |
| Generalist AI | 500,000+ h | manipulation data, about 9,000 end-effectors |
| Lightwheel EgoSuite | 100,000 h, open | egocentric video, commercial training allowed |
| Amazon ABC-130K | 3,553 h, open | 134,806 bimanual teleop episodes |
| China | [90+]{.k} data factories | operating or under construction |

: {tbl-colwidths="[26,24,50]"}

::: {.footnote}
China count: Interact Analysis, Aug 2026. The counterweight, Jul 2026: $\log N \propto 1/(P-c)$; precision is the one axis data volume does not buy.
:::

## Five architectures, one scoreboard

| Architecture | Scales on | Actions come from | August 2026 signal |
|:-------------|:---------:|:-----------------:|:-------------------|
| VLA | teleop demos | imitation head | &pi;0.5: RoboArena Elo [1609]{.k} |
| VLA + WM | demos + video | imitation, WM-guided | &pi;0.7 visual subgoals |
| World model | video | none: it imagines | real-time neural simulators |
| [WAM]{.k} | egocentric video | joint denoising | DreamZero: Elo [1736]{.mark} |
| Hybrid | everything | both pathways | the predicted winner |

: {tbl-colwidths="[15,20,27,38]"}

::: {.footnote}
NVIDIA, Jun 2026: WAM action tuning about 9 ZFLOPs, full video pretraining 50+, small VLA paths 7 to 10; inference 3 to 4x slower and closing.
:::
